title: Low-temperature fabrication of BTO-based relaxor ferroelectric thick films with multi-layered architecture

A screen‑printed BTO-based thick film with lead-free glass and sandwich structure enables low-temperature sintering (900 ℃). It achieves a high energy density of 1.65 J cm−3, efficiency of 74.3%.
